title: Pattern term algebra and AST
overview:
Need a formal, composable way for users to author workflows using only pattern primitives, preventing arbitrary graph structures and enabling compilation to executable forms.

**Motivation:** Ensures all workflows are well-formed by construction, enables semantic validation and compilation optimization, provides clear separation between authoring surface and runtime representation.

**Technical constraints:**
- Closed algebra - only generated by constructors
- Kernel basis patterns must be primitives
- Derived patterns implemented as library macros
- Include invariants checking in smart constructors

**Signals:** priority: critical, urgency: Foundation for all other components - must be defined first
